data.text:
FULL ROAD CLOSURE AT EDSA KAMUNING NORTHBOUND 

LOOK: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) announced on Tuesday, Dec. 9, the temporary closure of the northbound EDSA Busway Kamuning Station beginning Dec. 10, from 1:00 AM to 4:00 AM, due to concreting works on the new Kamuning footbridge.  

A full road closure will also be implemented during the same schedule.  Commuters are advised of the temporary rerouting plan and may board or alight at the Quezon Ave. or Nepa Q-Mart stations.  

“During this period, buses will not stop at Kamuning Station northbound and will be rerouted accordingly. Passengers may board or alight at the adjacent stations — Quezon Avenue or Nepa Q-Mart,” the DOTr said.  

Courtesy: Department of Transportation – Philippines/Facebook
